title: Gene Expression Signatures in Blood that Predict Mortality in a West African Sepsis Cohort Define Host Response Phenotypes
description: This study investigated the Ghanaian population's host immune response to sepsis over time. Subjects were selected from an observational sepsis study cohort previously described in Blair et.al., 2023 (PMID: 36806137). A group of 120 sepsis subjects was selected considering sex, age, and 28-day mortality criteria to generate a balanced group. A healthy donor cohort comprised 42 subjects. The time points collected include 0 (enrollment), 6, 24, 48, 72 hours, 28 days, 6, and 12 months post enrollment. Subjects' whole blood was sequenced, and results were used in a comprehensive analysis integrating clinical, laboratory, protein, and public sequencing data. As a result, the study defines 30 dynamic gene expression patterns related to cell-type specific molecular phenotypes in sepsis... (for more see dbGaP study page.)
